watches.name: Tiki - Coconut Brown
watches.description: Escape to the tropics with the Tiki - Coconut Brown. This distinctive timepiece captures the essence of island living with a striking brown dial reminiscent of the earthy shell of a coconut. The bamboo knot bezel adds authentic tiki character, while custom tiki-themed indices elevate the face of the watch. A playful pineapple date wheel* completes the design, bringing a touch of paradise to your wrist. Perfect for those who embrace adventure and tropical style. Diameter: 39mm Lug to Lug: 47mm Case Thickness: 11.8mm Water Resistance: 10 bar Movement: Automatic Seagull ST2130 Crystal: Sapphire Crystal with AR Coating *The first day of the month is replaced with a pineapple icon, days thereafter are shown in numerical format
